messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: almost same command ,but little difference
parts:
Hi,
It's not a bug. qplot wisely inspects a data and draw automatically
anappropriate geom.
So, the first form,
qplot(cty,data=mpg)+geom_histogram(binwidth=2)+facet_grid(cyl~.)
is equivalent to
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = cty)) + geom_bar() + geom_histogram(binwidth = 2)+
facet_grid(cyl~.)
you are drawing bar and histogram.
try this for more understanding:
qplot(cty,data=mpg)+geom_histogram(binwidth=2, colour =
"blue",fill=NA)+facet_grid(cyl~.)
and
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = cty)) + geom_bar() + geom_histogram(binwidth =
2,colour = "blue", fill=NA) + facet_grid(cyl~.)

--Kohske Takahashi <takahash...@gmail.com>

Tokyo, Japan.http://www.fennel.rcast.u-tokyo.ac.jp/profilee_ktakahashi.html
